bars_verbatim.SITE-DIES-TOO: if arm_b dies at the same brackets — sink-poisoning is organism death, full stop; 'COUPLED' is a misnomer; the type names need revisiting.

honesty_reflex.retention_base_choice: every retention is vs the SAME net's unmodified expression at the same geometry — the same convention e150's plane used; the custom-causal base is bit-identical to standard (mask gate), so path-matching cannot move a number.

recipe_deviations: Eval-only battery: both nets are LOADED, gated artifacts (e131 consolidated + e131 arm_b); nothing regenerated, nothing trained.

Every probe-A cell's base is the healthy consolidated net (the same base poison-alone and mask-alone were measured against in e150/e151); the mask path (custom forward, causal-only) is bit-identical to the standard forward (gated, max|dp(Z)| recorded), so path-matching is immaterial here — stated, recorded.

The joint cell is a doubly-off-distribution state (the net never trained under mask nor poison); its retention is read RELATIVE to the two single-intervention cells, not as an absolute health statement.
Probe-A verdict requires both geometries (g0 AND g-12) to fire the same registered branch; split geometries => MIXED-A with numbers (pre-registered before compute).
arm_b's ladder includes the 0.0 removal anchor (e150's ladder convention) and the dispatch-allowed 0.5 midpoint; the bars adjudicate on the registered brackets 0.07/0.15 only.
